Description:
This is the risk associated with failure
of the business to manage its cash flow,
debt and financial leverage impacting on
revenues and earnings.
These factors include:
• Foreign exchange changes
• interest rates changes
• Credit risk
Mitigation Actions:
Proactive forex risk mitigating measures in place ensure
the business is mitigated against adverse effects of
foreign exchange changes.
Interest rate risk is mitigated by strict adherence to our
investment policy that seeks to safeguard our interest-
earning investments.
We have a robust Credit Control function with credit
processes that are informed by a Credit policy that has
incorporated various credit risk control measures.
We do not have exposure to market risk
Our risk management process includes continuous
monitoring of exposure to financial risk to ensure
exposure is within the desired risk limits

Description:
We operate in a highly regulated
environment and may face legal challenges,
such as copyright infringement claims or
regulatory violations.
Mitigation Actions:
NMG minimizes compliance risk by monitoring legal and
regulatory developments to ensure that all its functions
and employees adhere to applicable laws, regulations,
codes of conduct and standards of good practice including
conforming to internal policies and standards of operation,
and with the highest ethical standard.

Description:
Cyber risk is the risk of a potential cyber-
attack that could potentially result to
business disruption, operations shut down,
theft of information assets, collection of
intelligence, or reputational damage.
Cyber-attacks frequency, severity and
sophistication continues to increase in
recent years worldwide.
Mitigation Actions:
NMG has invested extensive resources (human and
technological) in strengthening its information security
and cyber defense system
Various risk assessment techniques are deployed to
mitigate the risk of cybersecurity attacks
Cybersecurity awareness program are in place for all staff
to equip them with knowledge and skills to identify and
respond to cyber security threats

Description:
Being a media company, NMG is inherently
exposed to Libel risk
Mitigation Actions:
The Editorial policies and procedures in place serve to
ensure robust gatekeeping measures are in place within
the content generation and deployment processes.
Regular training is done for all Editorial staff on the
editorial policy and libel risk management.

Description:
Uncertainties and volatilities from
macroeconomic and geopolitical factors
have heavily impacted the business
environment and challenged our
management actions to monitor and
manage the macroeconomics risks.
Mitigation Actions:
NMG embraces diversification of our product offerings
including prioritizing digital products and expansion to
other geographical markets to mitigate the impact of
economic downturns or geopolitical disruptions.
We also maintain adequate cash reserves, optimize
working capital management, and regularly review
financial projections to ensure sufficient liquidity during
challenging periods.
We have also employed diverse financial strategies to
mitigate currency exchange rate risks, and commodity
price volatility that can arise from economic or geopolitical
uncertainties.
